source.title: Heart Failure with Preserved Ejection Fraction

source_integrity_issues: The PDF prints the PARAGLIDE-HF NT-proBNP geometric mean ratio as 0.85 with 95% CI 0.73 to 0.10. The interval is internally impossible and was not corrected.

The PDF states that the article was updated June 9, 2026. The official NEJM webpage retrieved August 23, 2026 states that it was updated July 9, 2026. This external version discrepancy is reported in SEA and not used to rewrite the PDF source.

Printed reference 8 labels the National Heart Failure Audit as a 2022 summary report but gives the date June 16, 2002 while the URL path also points to 2022. The reference queue preserves the printed citation.

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom model is oriented toward primary literature and has no dedicated kind for secondary trial reports or narrative-review recommendations. Those assertions are serialized mainly as atom_kind=other or author_conclusion with descriptive tags.
Formal guideline classes summarized in the review are retained in canonical statements and tags rather than dedicated recommendation fields.
extraction_limitations: This is a narrative Clinical Practice review, not a systematic review or primary trial. It does not report a reproducible literature search, risk-of-bias assessment, or evidence-grading method.
Bibliography entries were not atomized. They were exported as a separate reference task queue.
The selected packet contains the Supplementary Appendix but not the author disclosure PDF listed on NEJM.org.
All atoms remain needs_review because no human source-verification step is represented.

external_currency_verification.finding: The official NEJM page now reports a July 9, 2026 update date, and ACC published an updated 2026 HFpEF Expert Consensus Decision Pathway on July 23, 2026. Current-practice use should prioritize that newer ACC pathway where it differs from the older guideline summary in this article.
